title: Quantum resources constrain function approximation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30789v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Universal function approximation is central to machine learning. Quantum learning models are universal as well, but this does not specify the resources needed to approximate a given function. We study how coherence, imaginarity, entanglement and magic constrain function approximation for a fixed encoding and readout, using the cumulative resource power of the trainable gates. In a one-qubit model with phase encoding, coherence bounds the oscillation of the model function, while imaginarity bounds its odd part. In a two-qubit model, entanglement bounds the distance from product functions. These bounds hold at any encoding depth. For magic, the phase encoding itself supplies non-Clifford operations. On domains bounded away from zero, Clifford trainable gates suffice for uniform approximation. Replacing unrestricted trainable gates by Clifford gates increases the encoding depth at most polynomially in the original depth, the inverse error

translated_title: 量子资源约束函数逼近
translated_abstract: 通用函数逼近是机器学习的核心。量子学习模型同样具有通用性，但这并未说明逼近一个给定函数所需的资源。我们研究了在固定编码和读出方式下，相干性、虚性、纠缠和魔态资源如何通过可训练门的累积资源能力来约束函数逼近。在一个采用相位编码的单量子比特模型中，相干性限制了模型函数的振荡，而虚性限制了其奇部。在一个双量子比特模型中，纠缠限制了模型与乘积函数之间的距离。这些界在任何编码深度下均成立。对于魔态资源，相位编码本身就提供了非Clifford操作。在与零有界分离的定义域上，Clifford可训练门足以实现一致逼近。用Clifford门替换无限制的可训练门时，编码深度相对于原始深度和逆误差至多以多项式方式增加。
tldr: 该论文首次建立了量子资源（相干性、虚性、纠缠和魔态）与函数逼近能力之间的定量约束关系，证明了这些资源在任何编码深度下都会限定量子模型所能逼近函数的性质，并表明Clifford门在特定条件下足以实现一致逼近。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes quantitative constraints linking quantum resources—coherence, imaginarity, entanglement, and magic—to function approximation, proving that these resources bound the properties of approximable functions at any encoding depth, and showing that Clifford gates suffice for uniform approximation under certain conditions.
